balls.text: makes room and chops it to the off side
misses another one with a wild slog
comes down the pitch and swishes at thin air, Uthappa under arms the ball towards the stumps and misses and Harris gets back
clean hit! Backs away and bashes a length delivery across the line and clears deep midwicket
rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
tries to go over the on side but ends up chipping it to the off side
comes down the track and flat bats it just short of Steyn at mid-off
moves right across his stumps and runs it down to fine leg
Dropped The captain this time, Sumanth gets a top edge off a steep bouncer, Kumble runs back from square leg but fluffs it
clips it to the deep on the on side

the well-set Rohit goes! He chips a few paces down to a length ball and tries to swat it over wide long-on, it's a big ground so doesn't get enough elevation, Pandey runs to his right from long-on and takes it
punches it to the off side
turns it to the on side
googly, stays back and punches it to the off side

lucky for Uthappa! Symonds goes for a huge swing at a delivery from round the wicket and misses, his back foot is a inch or two out of the crease, Uthappa fails to pouch it but the ball rebounds off his gloves and hits the stumps before Symonds can drag his foot back, third umpire takes a look
attempts a slog but the ball hits his body and rolls away
punches it down to cover
opens the face and gently runs it down to third man, great day at work for Steyn
straightens outside the off stump and beats Symonds again, beaten for pace i guess
punches it with soft hands down to mid-off and sets off quickly
opens the face, steers it to point with soft hands
drifts down the leg side and Symonds tries to run it down to fine leg
loss of concentration from Symonds as he wafts at one outside off
reaches out and spoons it towards third man
he overpitches and Symonds uses the crease and bashes it past the bowler and Kohli at long-off
loses control of the ball and nearly lands it outside the pitch down the leg side
crisp! Makes a bit of room, frees his arms and comes down the track, hits straight over the bowler's head, one bounce and four
when the reverse sweep doesn't come off it looks a bit ugly, hits his body and drops on the pitch
continues over the wicket, comes down the track and clubs a ull toss down to Kohli at long-off
punches it down to long-off
booming drive down the pitch and the ball deflects off Appanna;s fingers and nearly hits the stumps
innovative and elegant! Rohit shuffles across his stumps and picks a length ball from outside off an clips it over square leg, terrific shot
chopped towards extra cover for a easy single
Kallis responds by bowling the quicker bouncer, swing and a miss
raw power! Kallis drops it much shorter and Symonds was expecting it, rocked back and butchered it over short midwicket
full on the off stump and driven to the off side
good bouncer, fizzes past Symonds as he sways back
sweeps but places it straight to short fine leg
comes round the wicket, he tucks it to the on side
pushes it towards cover point for a single
clipped just over Dravid's reach, two fielders in the deep pick it up
hesitation again! Symonds clips it to midwicket and sets off ans hurries back, poor throw from Dravid to the keeper's end
takes a single to long-off
tucks it down to midwicket
pushes it to extra cover

No communication at all! Apanna bowls over the wicket, Rohit drives down to deep cover and settles for a single, Mishra charges out for the second but fails to glance at Rohit who signalled him to stay put at the other end, Steyn's throw was accurate to the keeper and Mishra was stuck at Rohit's end, Mishra wasnt paying attention at all to his partner
gets a bit of width and he slices it to short third man
drives away from the body and he's beaten
punches it to the off side for a single
on a roll! Kallis drops it short and Rohit rocks back and pulls over square leg, more in the region of long leg
from elegance to power! Kallis bowls round the wicket and fires it full and wide, Rohit drives fiercely wide of short cover and the sweeper
cheeyk and clever! Gets his front foot forward and paddles it from outside off and places it wide of fine leg
uses the crease and pulls a length delivery down to long-on
pulls it down to deep midwicket for a single
classic shot! He sashays down the pitch to a flighted delivery on middle and lofts off the meat of the bat and clears the sight screen
punches it straight to short cover
stays back and punches to long-on
no turn this time but it beats him outside off
Appanna gives him width, reaches out and slams it in the air over short cover, the sweeper cuts it off
pushes it down to extra cover
comes down the pitch and punches it down to cover
whams it down the pitch and past the bowler Kallis does really well at long-on to sprint and slide to his left and release the ball before he touches the rope
good calling, he pushes it softly down to the vacant mid-on region and sets his sight on the second after some aggressive running
clean hit! Takes a few paces down the track, gets under the bounce and lofts nicely through the line over long-off, the ball seems to be lost
full on the off stump and driven to the off side
pushes a full delivery through the line wide of long-off for a couple
another googly, tucked down to midwicket
good shot, Mishra gives him the charge, picks it on a length and mows it a few rows behind at deep midwicket
fails to make use of the Free Hit and ends up smacking it back to the bowler
he oversteps! Comes round the wicket and Rohit chips it over mid-of,, drops in front of the fielder in the deep
another googly, tucked down to midwicket
comes down the track but checks his shot on seeing the googly, punches it to the off side
stays at the crease and pushes it through the line to long-on
times the cover drive nicely but finds the sweeper Appanna
comes down the pitch and forces it to White at long-off
punches it to the covers and Rohit scampers back
another inside edge off a drive, the ball his pads
full on middle and leg and pushed through the line to long-on
gets forward and punches him down to cover
gets a thick inside edge onto his boot on the drive
excellent shot and good placement, he rocks back to a short of a length ball and pulls along the turf past midwicket, picks the gap between long-on and deep midwicket, good dose of power on that one
makes just a bit of room and cuts him down to deep point
tossed up on middle and leg, he works it wide of square leg
full on the pads and pushed wide of mid-on
drifts on the pads and he works it down to square leg
slower ball and he checks his drive to cover
drifts on the pads and he works it down to midwicket
good placement by Mishra, he picks a length delivery from middle, stands on one leg and pulls him in the gap between short fine leg and square leg
a slower ball and he fetches it from outside off and pulls him wide of square leg, deep midwicket mops up
angles on the body and he clips it straight to square leg
pierces the off side! Rohit gets beside the line and punches it with the swing wide of short cover
length delivery on the pads and he gently works it away down to Apannna at fine leg
bangs it in short and Mishra sways out of the way and lets that go
tucks it down to midwicket for a single
edged! Rohit tries to drive through cover and gets a edge, the ball dips low and lands on the first bounce to Dravid at first slip
Steyn continues, he drifts on the pads and he clips it just wide of Uthappa who dives
picks a length delivery and he pulls on one leg to deep midwicket, there's protection
comes down the pitch but he can only force it straight to mid-on
god use of the wrists again and he places it wide of short fine leg, Steyn does the chasing
uses his wrists and pushes it down to mid-on
tucked towards square leg, Mishra ambles out of his crease but is sent back
he clips it down to square leg and takes an easy single
fiery delivery at the base of the stumps, he just manages to squeeze it out to third man
skids through and he tucks it to the off side
strays down the leg side, rare bad delivery

through the gate! Steyn take a bow, he bowls it fuller and straight at the stumps, Gibbs was beaten for pace, went straight through and hit the off and middle stumps, the stumps are upright and the bails go flying, 143 kph there
slower ball, he tucks it down to midwicket
living a charmed life here, he drives away from his body and gets a thick inside edge which nearly shaves the stumps and runs to fine leg
stays beside the line and taps it to the off side
tucks it off his pads to fine leg, Rohit wasn't too quick on the second run and he just about made it back, good throw from fine leg
stays back and taps it down the pitch
gives him the charge and muscles a good length delivery several rows back over deep midwicket, vintage Gibbs
stays beside the line and taps it to the off side
really should have been a third wicket! Gibbs plays a short arm pull and Taylor jumps too early at short midwicket, makes a complete mess of it, the ball bounces off his palms
not quite the best hat-trick ball, he angles it on the pads and Sharma pushes it to mid-on

he's on a hat-trick! Excellent bowling and field placement, he digs it in short to the Indian batsman, he uneasily fends it off his body and Taylor is there at backward short leg to take the easiest of catches
Gilly has walked! Steyn angles it across the left-hander, very minimal fott movement, gets a thin edge to the keeper, Uthappa knows it immediately
gets beside the line and punches it to the off side
this time he holds the length back, good carry through to the keeper, left alone
gets nice away swing straight up, Gibbs prods forward and is beaten
run-out! Appanna makes room and scoops it down to deep point, risky second run but the throw from Rohit is accurate to Gilchrist and he whips off the bails, Tiffenn doesn't call for the third umpire
timber! Harris fires a yorker on the off stump, the batsman makes room again and swings, the off stump is flattened
he sees the batsman making room and fires too wide outside off, no way anyone could have chased that
it's a full toss and he can only put it away to cover
fires it full and on the leg stump line, he fails to make contact and the ball nearly shaves the stump
slower ball just outside the off stump, Vinay swishes at thin air, top class over by Harmeet
Vinay leaves the ball probably thinking it would be a wide, nope it was perfectly legitimate
comes down the pitch and gets an inside edge down to short fine leg
Gilchrist goes back, bowls the slower ball and Kumble drives away from the body and misses
Harmeet Singh Bansal's on a hat-trick! Steyn goes right across his stumps and tries to sweep him, exposes all three stumps and the ball hits the back leg flush in front of the stumps, see you later!
could be the most important strike of the match! Harmeet bowls yet another leg cutter and Uthappa swishes hard and misses it completely, knocks the off stump
good running from Vinay! He jams out a low full toss to long-off and he pushes for the second so that Uthappa will have strike
Dropped but he saved a boundary! Thick outside edge on the drive and Gilly flings himself to his right and gloves it down to third man
could this be the turning point! Harris bowls length again and Uthappa makes room and clubs it over wide long-on
that looked like a certain boundary but Symonds was awesome at deep cover, powerful front foot drive
a trifle wide outside off and the batsmen made room to drive, Russel Tiffen signals pretty late and Harris isnt happy with the call
now he bowls it fuller and he crashes it down to long-on, they put pressure on Sumanth and go for the second, Vinay times his dive well, third umpire takes a look
this time he bowls it too short and is penalised
what a response! Harris bowls length to Uthappa and he makes room and slaps it high and far over the bowler's head
great keeping there! Vinay tries to smash it down the ground but gets an under edge and Gilchrist falls to his left and stops it
Vinay makes room and tries to scoop it past short third man but misses it completely
full outside off and he reaches out and scoops it over extra cover
full and fast on the pads and the ball deflects to short third man

well Symonds was in action after all! White stays at the crease and tries to slam it straight down the ground, thick top edge and it swirls towards long-on, Symonds runs across to his left and takes the skier
full toss outside off and he clubs it down to long-on
Ojha unlucky there, managed to get some turn and induce an outside edge past slip and short third man
gets on his knee and paddles it down to fine leg
gets on his knee and sweeps to Harmeet at deep square leg
Sumanth in action again! Ojha gives it more air, Kohli is tempted into the loft and he gets forward and lofts it flat down Sumanth's throat at long-on
fires it full and flat and he defends forward
excellent running, he tucks it to midwicket and Ojha has to do the chasing, they push for the second
almost a fifth wicket there! Drives away from the body and gets a thick inside edge past the stumps
RP take a bow! He bowls a superb yorker on the leg stump line, Taylor once again plays all around it and misses it completely, the ball knocks the leg stump back
close shout for lbw! Pitches full on middle and leg and he plays all around it, hits the base of the pads, Rudi Koertzen shakes his head
pulls him down to long-on
bashes it straight to short extra cover and Rohit has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end and just misses
chases a really wide one outside off, squirts it wide of cover point
another ripper! Spins away and beats him outside off
squares him up and hits his pads but outside the line of off stump
makes room and cuts to the off side
Kallis tries to open up, he chips down the track and tries a straight six, he lofts it several miles in the air, almost as if he was aiming for the blimp, Sumanth takes it well at long-on
top edge and it drops safe! Tries to mow him over midwicket but the ball lands in front of midwicket, no fielder there and Ojha chases in vain
taps it down to cover and takes  an easy single
backs away but Symonds fires it on the body and cramps him up, he tucks it wide of square leg
worked just wide of square leg
breaks the shackles! Tossed up on the off stump and he gets on his knee and swats it flat and quick over deep midwicket
tries to paddle it away but places it to short fine leg
swings it inwards and he tucks it off his pads
full on the off stump and punched to cover
full on the off stump and driven down to long-off
full on middle and leg and pushed to long-on
shapes to drive straighter but he mistimes it to short fine leg
full on the off stump and jammed down the ground to long-on
bowls it straight and he knocks it straight back to the bowler
Harmeet is only bowling leg cutters today, driven down to long-off
the offspinner this time and he pounds it down the ground to long-off
works it down to long-on for a single
clips it down to midwicket
against the run of play! Symonds cuts back on the pace and he bowls an off break, Dravid was lured by the flight and he ended up lofting it down long-off's throat
tucks it just wide of midwicket
it's a full toss and Kallis can only work it to midwicket
persists with the leg cutter, Kallis steers it to point
yet another leg cutter, he rocks back and pulls down to long-on
steers it to the off side for a single
he bowls another leg cutter, googly in fact, beats the batsman
delicately played, he opens the face of the bat to a slower ball and runs it down to third man
tries to tucks it away but the ball hits his pads and rolls away
pushes it down to cover
pushes it down to long-off
well played! Symonds gives him width and he opens the face of the bat and edges it just wide of a diving Ojha at short third man
stays back and punches him down to sweeper cover
driven down to long-off
the slower ball, punched to long-on
poor over so far, he bowls too full and wide outside off, he chases it and it's a thick outside edge and beats the keeper
that's a cracker! Drops it short of a lenght and wide outside off,  he reaches out and slaps it wide of backward point
tucks it in the air but just wide of midwicket
taps it square of the wicket on the off side
this time he goes the other side, too wide to flash at that
he slips it wide down the leg side
drills it down to long -on and that's the Time Out
close shout for lbw! The ball straightens and hits the flap of his back pad in line with leg, that could have been given out actually
gets a little forward and drives to mid-off
stays back and chops it down to cover
down the leg side and he runs it down to fine leg
lovely shot, flighted outside off and he comes down the track and lots inside out over extra cover
he pulls firmly to deep square leg
sprays it too wide outside the off stump and the ball brushes the keeper's gloves and runs to third man
tucks it down to square leg
tries to mow it over the on side but mistimes it
bowls the bouncer and he sways away
he comes down the pitch to chase a delivery shaping away from him, Gilchrist and the bowler think he edged it
stays back and punches him straight to cover
defended to the off side
nearly squares him up with a ripper! Turn and bounce from middle, beats him and nearly shaves the stump
knocked towards short fine leg off the pads, Dravid wasn't sure but Kallis wanted the run
makes a bit of room and then defends forward
turned towards mid-on
drops it too short, he has enough time to rock back and slap it past cover
tucked to mid-on
pushes it down to point
drops it a  bit short and he pulls past the infield and placs it to deep midwicket
not bowling to his field here, he slides down the leg side and he gently runs it down to fine leg with the fielder up
beats him for pace this time, not sure if he wanted to play a shot
drops it too short and Dravid pulls along the turf and places it well wide of short fine leg, good placement
slaps him hard wider of backward point but RP was squarer at third man and that enabled him to slide and cut it off
takes a quick single to midwicket, Mishra dives and under arms the throw but just misses the stumps, good commitment
the short ball gets a bit high on him and he miscues the pull but it drops behind midwicket
knocks him on the pads bu too high, stifled appeal from Harris
lands outside off and he leaves it alone
short on middle, gets back and whips it away towards fine leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, a touch of away movement and Kallis lets it be
sent back by Kallis and Dravid makes it back just in time, has to stretch and dive to stick his bat in but there wasn;t any direct hit
flicked away towards fine leg, a touch too straight
shortish outside off, keeps a little low, leaves it alone
down the leg side, bowled short and Kallis tries to tickle it fine but can't connect
lovely shot, bowled it full on the off and he leant into the drive and caressed it through mid-off and extra cover
gives him width and he punches it wide of backward point, RP does  well to slide from third man and save it
nips back in and hits him high on the pads
classic Dravid! Not a bad ball, outside off and he shows the full face of the bat and effortlessly  punches it past cover point and backward point
stays back and drops it back to the bowler
nice bounce and carry, Dravid gets his foot forward and shoulders arms
Harris strikes first ball! He lands it a touch wide outside off and has Pandey fishing at it, the ball moves away off the seam and takes the edge, poor shot and just the start Deccan needed
